# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest commit on `main` is supported. Older tags and releases get no
fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report privately through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting — the
[Security tab](https://github.com/dayjournal/leaflet-starter/security/advisories/new)
of this repository. Please do not open a public issue for a security problem.

This is a personal starter project maintained in spare time: there is no
bounty, and replies are best effort, usually within two weeks. Fixes land on
`main`, and the advisory is published once a fix is available.
